checks.label: Repeated points and arrows save immediately without a dialog or scrolling away from the image
Finish and Enter save open traces without opening the editor; fewer than three vertices cannot close
Clicking near the starting vertex joins the tail with a closing edge and no duplicate vertex
The selected-trace control reopens and closes the same mark without losing its label, note or vertices
The explicit Close trace button joins a draft with at least three vertices
Continue explicitly reopens a closed trace, appends a vertex, and preserves its identity and notes
The detailed note editor still opens on an explicit Edit action and retains closure
A delayed Continue cannot reopen an old trace or steal selection after the user changes tool and draws another mark
Automatic saving and reload preserve every open and closed trace, notes and native coordinates without changing anatomical decisions
ZIP download, fresh-profile upload and reload preserve closed traces exactly
JSON download, fresh-profile upload and reload preserve closed traces exactly
